investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Juniperhollow Learning (online learning); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.60.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster junipe-prod-uswest (EKS); Database: postgres server video-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-5be99d576217a96f7; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
